summary: Hang Feng Technology Innovation Co., Ltd. files Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at an EGM on June 12, 2026, for a share capital reclassification (creating Class A and Class B ordinary shares), a US$400 repurchase of 4,000,000 Class A shares from Hang Feng International Holdings, and a simultaneous issuance of 4,000,000 Class B shares to the same entity at par value. The aggregate consideration for the repurchase is paid from the proceeds of the fresh issuance. Approximately 54.68% of shares were represented. These steps appear structured to grant Hang Feng International enhanced voting control via multi-class share structure with no premium or material cash outflow. Watch for potential future delisting risk or governance changes.
